name: reva-intel
description: Ask revenue, occupancy, booking, review and operations questions about your vacation rental company in Reva Intel.

interface.longDescription: Reva Intel is the business intelligence warehouse for vacation rental companies. It joins reservations, stay nights, revenue, guest reviews, cleans and maintenance, guests and owners from your PMS, operations software and review channels. Connect it to ask in plain language about occupancy, ADR and RevPAR, revenue by property or channel, booking lead times, cancellations, review trends and cleaning performance. The assistant reads the warehouse schema and runs read-only SQL, and for companies that connected them it can also read Google Analytics and live data from their PMS and operations software. You see only the companies where you have Reva Intel access, under the same data policy as the Reva Intel chat.
defaultPrompt: What were my occupancy, ADR and RevPAR last month?
Which 10 properties earned the most this year?
How far ahead do guests book in summer?

positive.description: Lists the companies the user can query.
positive.prompt: Which companies can I query in Reva Intel?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_companies and lists the demo company as slug and name.

positive.description: Computes last month's occupancy, ADR and RevPAR.
positive.prompt: What were my occupancy, ADR and RevPAR last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the metrics glossary skill, reads the schema and runs SQL on fact_stay_nights for last month, then reports the three metrics with the numbers behind them.

positive.prompt: Which 10 properties earned the most revenue this year, and how many nights did each book?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs SQL that sums revenue and nights per property this year and lists the top 10.

positive.prompt: How many cleans did we do last week, and which day had the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs SQL on fact_tasks for last week's cleans and reports the total and the busiest day.

positive.description: Reports booking lead time by month.
positive.prompt: What is the average booking lead time for each month of this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs SQL on fact_reservations grouped by month and reports the average days between booking and check-in.

negative.description: Changing a rate is a write. Every Reva Intel tool is read-only, so the assistant must say it cannot change prices.
negative.prompt: Set the nightly rate of my beach house to $300 for next weekend.

negative.description: Cancelling a reservation is a write and is not possible through Reva Intel. The assistant must say it cannot cancel bookings.
negative.prompt: Cancel the reservation for the guest arriving tomorrow.

negative.description: The request has nothing to do with the company's data, so no Reva Intel tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to the Reva Intel warehouse, with Google Analytics and live PMS and operations software reads for companies that connected them.
